seoTitle: Add Reviews to Shopify From 6 Marketplaces
metaDescription: Import reviews into Shopify from AliExpress, Amazon, Etsy, eBay, DSers, and Temu in one workflow, then customize the widget to match your theme.
intro: Building trust on a new Shopify store often comes down to how many genuine reviews visitors can see, and this guide covers pulling them from six different marketplaces in one workflow. You'll install a review app, connect it to your store, import from AliExpress, Amazon, Etsy, eBay, DSers, and Temu, and then customize the review widget so star ratings, photos, and feedback match your theme.

steps.heading: Install the reviews app
steps.body: Add a review-import app to your Shopify store that supports connecting to multiple external marketplaces.

steps.heading: Import reviews from AliExpress
steps.body: Connect the app to your AliExpress product listings and pull in the existing customer reviews for each item.

steps.heading: Import reviews from Amazon and Etsy
steps.body: Repeat the process for matching products on Amazon and Etsy to widen the pool of genuine feedback on your store.

steps.heading: Import reviews from eBay and DSers
steps.body: Continue pulling reviews from eBay and DSers listings so your catalog has coverage across all major sourcing platforms.

steps.heading: Import reviews from Temu
steps.body: Round out the import by adding reviews from Temu product pages as well.

steps.heading: Customize review display and star ratings
steps.body: Once imported, adjust the widget's layout, star ratings, and photo display so reviews look native to your store's theme.

faq.question: Can I really pull reviews from six different marketplaces into one store?
faq.answer: Yes, the workflow covers importing reviews from AliExpress, Amazon, Etsy, eBay, DSers, and Temu using a single review app.

faq.question: Is this suitable for beginners?
faq.answer: Yes, the process is designed to work for both beginners and advanced Shopify sellers who want to add social proof.

faq.question: Will imported reviews include star ratings and photos?
faq.answer: Yes, the customization step covers displaying star ratings, customer photos, and written feedback.

faq.question: Does this work for dropshipping and print-on-demand stores?
faq.answer: Yes, it works for dropshipping, print-on-demand, and branded Shopify stores alike.
